metric_semantics.bitmap_derivation: sum of measured VisibleResult, Begin, Row, and Finish callback durations for exact bitmap derivation
metric_semantics.connector_overhead: connector wall time excluding visible/provenance query-to-drain timers and separately reported VisibleResult work
metric_semantics.direct_sql: client wall time for the configured semantically corresponding read-only SQL
metric_semantics.exposure_derivation: post-stream Finish duration retained for backward-compatible component analysis
metric_semantics.novel: distinct request whose semantic replay key was absent; overlap is exact charged-vs-actual V4 novelty in the configured dimension
metric_semantics.observer: delta of monotonic counters and/or cgroup peak values returned by the configured external observer
metric_semantics.ordinal_finish: post-stream Finish and immutable Control-observation construction duration
metric_semantics.ordinal_stream: ordinal companion query-to-drain wall time including network, decoding, and synchronous consumer callbacks
metric_semantics.ordinal_stream_consumer: sum of synchronously measured Begin/Row callback durations contained in ordinal_stream
metric_semantics.ordinal_visible_preparation: VisibleResult callback duration measured between the visible and provenance statements
metric_semantics.provenance_postgresql: ordinal companion query-to-drain wall time minus synchronously measured Begin/Row consumer callbacks
metric_semantics.semantic_replay: same task and plan under a distinct request_id after a committed novel result
metric_semantics.settle_persist: Gateway-reported atomic V4 settlement, result/audit persistence, and root-head CAS store duration
metric_semantics.storage: PostgreSQL pg_total_relation_size plus exact filesystem byte counts; projected per-root values are labeled estimates
metric_semantics.wal: pg_wal_lsn_diff around the operation; relation-level attribution is not inferred

storage.semantics: fixed artifacts are amortized by projected roots; runtime bytes/root is the page-granular measured runtime-table total divided by measured nonzero-epoch roots
